en: Color postcard view of a broad European city street or square lined with ornate historic buildings. On the left is a light-colored, richly decorated corner building with a rounded tower and dark dome. On the right are tall, narrow buildings with steep red roofs and Gothic-revival details, including pointed towers. The street is busy with pedestrians, a few early motor vehicles, and what appears to be a small tram or trolley. Low hills are visible in the distant background under a blue, partly cloudy sky. The overall look is mid‑20th‑century, likely in Eastern or Central Europe.
